action_args.justification: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (trend strength 0.999, non-stationary) with minimal seasonality. A selective single-model choice is the right call for this trend-dominated, high-predictability series.

   - Moderate ranking stability (Kendall tau 0.688)
   - Correlated error groups exist - 10 groups, 5 independent
   - Redundant groups: CWT_rf/CWT_catboost/ONLY_CWT_rf/ONLY_DWT_rf are correlated; DWT_rf/FT_rf/DWT_catboost/FT_catboost are correlated

   - Leader: a5 (trimmed_mean pool1, 5 models) score -0.0948

   - All baselines are in the mix
   - The full-pool strategies (mean, median, dba) are much worse
   - Weighted (w1) is also bad (0.2331)

   - The ranking is moderate stability
   - Only 3 validation windows - weight estimation is high variance
